compat._note: playsWith: {inputs} is a list of the inputsInList texts.

inputsInList._note: The inputs as they read inside the list of playsWith (lower case in English).

withInputs._note: The end of a sentence saying how a game is played, for example "Up to 4 players on one PC, with controllers".
withInputs.controllersKeyboardMouse: with controllers or keyboard and mouse
withInputs.controllersMultiKeyboardMouse: with controllers or several keyboards and mice
withInputs.keyboardMouseMultiKeyboardMouse: with keyboard and mouse or several keyboards and mice
withInputs.all: with controllers, keyboard and mouse or several keyboards and mice

glyph._note: Names of gamepad buttons read by screen readers. Button letters and L1 / R1 are key caps.

appLanguage.label: Language

alreadyRunning.title: Nucleus Co-op is already running
alreadyRunning.message: Nucleus Co-op is already running. If you don't see its window, it may be running in the background: close the process with Task Manager.

missingFile.title: Missing file
